notes: The 18-passage baseline contains twelve manually checked NCISM curriculum excerpts and six short editorial summaries from selected pages of a user-provided 2008 CCRAS safety manual. The 36-passage corpus adds further NCISM excerpts and two Ayusoft context records. The separate synthetic demo corpus uses synthetic_reference_paraphrase_not_source_evidence. Summaries are not verbatim excerpts. No records are domain-expert-reviewed. Reuse/redistribution rights remain unreviewed. Do not ingest this schema file as evidence.
